title: W10881701 — Service Test Mode
description: From Service Diagnostics, press 2nd button then START — L1/L2/heater/airflow sequence; step 8 verifies water spray.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 9.2 Cu. Ft. Steam Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Enter Service Test Mode
steps.body: With Service Diagnostic mode active, press and release the 2nd diagnostic button, then press and release START. Display shows 888 for 2 sec; START flashes. Press START to begin L2 → L1 → heater → airflow sequence. Step 8 verifies water valve spray.
steps.sourceExcerpt: User enters Service Test Mode through Service Diagnostics.
